<translated_code>
n, t = map(int, input().split())
inp = [input().strip() for _ in range(n)]
source_cap = [[0]*n for _ in range(n)]
sink_cap = [[0]*n for _ in range(n)]
plant = [[[0]*61 for _ in range(n)] for _ in range(n)]
flo = [[0]*200 for _ in range(200)]
dr = [0, 0, -1, 1]
dc = [-1, 1, 0, 0]

def is_valid(r, c):
    return 0 <= r < n and 0 <= c < n

# Process initial source grid
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(n):
        ch = inp[i][j]
        if ch in ('Y', 'Z'):
            plant[i][j][0] = ord(ch) - ord('X')
            source_cap[i][j] = 0
        else:
            plant[i][j][0] = 0
            source_cap[i][j] = int(ch)

# Read sink grid
inp_sink = [input().strip() for _ in range(n)]
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(n):
        ch = inp_sink[i][j]
        if ch in ('Y', 'Z'):
            plant[i][j][0] = ord(ch) - ord('X')
            sink_cap[i][j] = 0
        else:
            plant[i][j][0] = 0
            sink_cap[i][j] = int(ch)

# Simulate plant growth over time
for curr_time in range(1, t+1):
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(n):
            plant[i][j][curr_time] = plant[i][j][curr_time - 1]
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(n):
            if plant[i][j][curr_time - 1] == 2:
                for k in range(4):
                    ni, nj = i + dr[k], j + dc[k]
                    if is_valid(ni, nj) and plant[ni][nj][curr_time - 1] == 0:
                        plant[ni][nj][curr_time] = 2

node_id = 1
source_num = [[-1]*n for _ in range(n)]
sink_num = [[-1]*n for _ in range(n)]

for i in range(n):
    for j in range(n):
        if source_cap[i][j] != 0:
            source_num[i][j] = node_id
            node_id += 1
        else:
            source_num[i][j] = -1

for i in range(n):
    for j in range(n):
        if sink_cap[i][j] != 0:
            sink_num[i][j] = node_id
            node_id += 1
        else:
            sink_num[i][j] = -1

from collections import deque

# Build flow network
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(n):
        if source_cap[i][j] != 0:
            q = deque()
            q.append((0, i, j))
            vis = [[False]*n for _ in range(n)]
            vis[i][j] = True
            while q:
                curr_time, r, c = q.popleft()
                if sink_cap[r][c] != 0:
                    flo[source_num[i][j]][sink_num[r][c]] = 10000
                if curr_time == t:
                    continue
                if plant[r][c][curr_time] != 0:
                    continue
                for k in range(4):
                    nr, nc = r + dr[k], c + dc[k]
                    if is_valid(nr, nc) and plant[nr][nc][curr_time] == 0 and not vis[nr][nc]:
                        q.append((curr_time + 1, nr, nc))
                        vis[nr][nc] = True

# Connect source and sink capacities
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(n):
        if source_cap[i][j] != 0:
            flo[0][source_num[i][j]] = source_cap[i][j]
        if sink_cap[i][j] != 0:
            flo[sink_num[i][j]][node_id] = sink_cap[i][j]

def get_path():
    parent = [-1]*(node_id+1)
    parent[0] = 0
    q = deque([0])
    while q:
        top = q.popleft()
        if top == node_id:
            break
        for i in range(node_id+1):
            if flo[top][i] and parent[i] == -1:
                parent[i] = top
                q.append(i)
    if parent[node_id] == -1:
        return 0
    ans = 10000
    pos = node_id
    while pos != 0:
        ans = min(ans, flo[parent[pos]][pos])
        pos = parent[pos]
    pos = node_id
    while pos != 0:
        flo[parent[pos]][pos] -= ans
        flo[pos][parent[pos]] += ans
        pos = parent[pos]
    return ans

total_flow = 0
while True:
    flow = get_path()
    if flow == 0:
        break
    total_flow += flow

print(total_flow)
